name: Prince Edmund Alpin
source:
A handsome, chivalrous and brilliant crown prince is usually the male lead in cliched romance novels. What kind of heroine could resist a man who could crown her queen?
Yet Prince Edmund is so obviously the prime suspect for being Jane's former fiance that he almost cannot be the man out to murder me...
